proposed.text: When a private architect is engaged to work with a government in-house team, what is the most critical source-backed point in the service agreement?

options.text: The consultant should never sign any documents for a public project
The in-house office should absorb all Article 1723 responsibility automatically
The agreement must identify who prepares, reviews, signs, seals, and remains responsible for the architectural documents
RA 9184 eliminates the need for RA 9266 compliance

proposed.rationale: The project record must allocate document preparation, review, signature, seal, and approval roles.
